# yii3-mcp-telemetry-bridge

Observability for rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp servers: one trace span + RED-style
metrics per MCP `tools/call`, via rasuvaeff/yii3-telemetry (tracing core)
and rasuvaeff/yii3-metrics (metrics core).

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-telemetry-bridge
```

## Rules

- Two interceptors, independent: use `TracingToolCallInterceptor` and/or
  `MetricsToolCallInterceptor`; each implements yii3-mcp's
  `ToolCallInterceptorInterface`.
- Tool exceptions are ALWAYS rethrown unchanged — the bridge never alters
  the MCP error envelope. On failure the span gets the recorded exception +
  `Error` status; the counter gets `outcome="error"`.
- Arguments reach the span as one SCALAR attribute per argument
  (`mcp.tool.argument.<name>`): masked by yii3-mcp's `ArgumentMasker`
  (case-insensitive key match at every nesting level; default keys:
  password, secret, token, api_key, credit_card), stringified (arrays as
  JSON) and truncated at 200 bytes. Never a single array attribute — the
  OTel attribute model would drop it.
- Budget rejections are invisible to this bridge (yii3-mcp auto-adds the
  budget interceptor outermost). Interceptor/tool rejections
  (ToolCallException) count as `outcome=rejected` via yii3-mcp CallOutcome;
  `error` = unexpected failures only.
- Metric names are Prometheus-strict; the duration histogram has no
  `outcome` label (cardinality) — errors are counted by the counter.
- Put `TracingToolCallInterceptor` first (outermost) in the interceptor
  list so the span covers the whole chain.
- `sessionBudget` ctor param only feeds the `mcp.session.budget_remaining`
  span attribute; enforcement stays in yii3-mcp's `SessionBudgetInterceptor`.

## API

### TracingToolCallInterceptor

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpTelemetryBridge\TracingToolCallInterceptor;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\ArgumentMasker;

new TracingToolCallInterceptor(
    tracer: $tracer,                       // Rasuvaeff\Yii3Telemetry\TracerInterface
    argumentMasker: new ArgumentMasker(),  // optional
    sessionBudget: 50,                     // optional, >= 1; throws InvalidArgumentException otherwise
);
```

Span: name `mcp.tool <tool>`; attributes `mcp.tool`,
`mcp.tool.argument.<name>` (masked + stringified + truncated, one per
argument), `mcp.outcome` (`success`/`rejected`/`error` — yii3-mcp CallOutcome), `mcp.client.id` (when the
transport carries one), `mcp.client.name`/`mcp.client.version` (initialize
handshake), `mcp.session.id`, `mcp.session.calls_used`,
`mcp.session.budget_remaining` (only with `sessionBudget`).

### MetricsToolCallInterceptor

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpTelemetryBridge\MetricsToolCallInterceptor;
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\MetricRegistry;

new MetricsToolCallInterceptor(
    metrics: $registry,                    // Rasuvaeff\Yii3Metrics\MetricRegistry
    durationBuckets: [0.05, 0.1, 0.5],     // optional list<float>, seconds
);
```

Metrics: `mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,outcome}` (counter; outcome =
success/rejected/error),
`mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{tool}` (histogram, hrtime wall time of the
wrapped chain, observed on success and failure).

### Wiring (Yii3 params)

```php
'rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp' => [
    'interceptors' => [
        Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpTelemetryBridge\TracingToolCallInterceptor::class,
        Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpTelemetryBridge\MetricsToolCallInterceptor::class,
    ],
],
```

stdio (`mcp:serve`) is long-running: configure the tracing backend to export
per call (batch processor with scheduled delay, or simple processor).
